title: QCGD manuscript source data
format: CSV with UTF-8 encoding and a header row
excluded: Full statevectors, compiled circuits, Python pickle containers, caches, and generated plots.
provenance_note: Values were extracted from the authors local legacy result files. Legacy pickle files are not distributed.

files.SHA256SUMS: SHA-256 checksums for all distributed source-data files.
files.figure5_slices.csv: One-dimensional gamma slices plotted in Figure 5.
files.figures6_8_results.csv: Energy, fidelity, and compiled-resource values underlying Figures 6-8.
files.selected_parameters.csv: Selected mu and gamma values for canonical runs.
files.table3_matched_fidelity_resources.csv: Unrounded values and counts underlying Table III.
